scope: read-only CI9 Linux TLS driver diagnosis; no maintained source changes or builds

source_trace.fact: execute creates memfd using syscall 279, writes embedded native artifact, then executes /proc/self/fd/3 through ExtraFiles.
Image.bind gets current_exe and immediately canonicalizes that pathname before registry protection.
lo_cli_main returns status2 without output if Console.cli admission fails.

diagnosis: Linux current_exe for memfd execution names the anonymous deleted memfd image; that pathname cannot canonicalize to a retained filesystem artifact. This causes pre-evaluation Console admission failure. The reported failure does not establish a TLS or certificate failure.
verification_limit: Source diagnosis and matching CI failure signature; no new instrumented guest run while CI9 source is frozen.

existing_packaging.simple_runner: tools/nativeruntime/run.py packages only /probe, libraries, argument/stdin protocol, optional opted-in empty capture file; no general companion API.
existing_packaging.batch_runner: tools/loqualification/batch.py supports declared source/path payloads, but moving this single integration test to the batch lane would expand its dependencies.

changes: Add explicit repository-local ELF companion packaging at one fixed guest path /companion, using the existing built native artifact without permission-mode operations.
Add Go helper for driver+companion: QEMU passes /companion; direct Linux ARM64 passes the original absolute artifact path.
Require TLS driver argv[1] and execute that stable artifact; remove embedded program, memfd creation and ExtraFiles.
Preserve trusted, wrong-name, untrusted, payload/status assertions and exactly-one remote request oracle.
acceptance: Existing CI9 failure is the public red.
Focused TestLLVMLinuxHTTPVerifiedTLS must pass all three receipt scenarios.
Focused existing Linux core/Console output must remain green.
not_selected: memfd-specific image identity or helper transport
